title: Software Renewals, Contracts & OEM Bundle Tracking
author_notes: Effort tier: T3 (renewal calendar + contract repository + procurement coordination; moderate process build).
hook: Never get blindsided by a software renewal again
problem: Renewals arrive without warning, auto-renew at bad terms, or lapse and break something in production — and OEM bundles and contract terms live in people's inboxes. This solution builds a repeatable software renewals, contracts, and OEM bundle tracking process: a renewal calendar with lead-time alerts, a contract and entitlement repository, OEM/bundle mapping, and a procurement coordination workflow so every renewal is a planned decision.
whats_inside: Solution Overview — the renewal lifecycle, the contract/entitlement repository model, OEM bundle mapping, lead-time alerting, and the procurement coordination workflow.

Requirements Guide — every prerequisite (a contract/entitlement repository, renewal dates and terms, procurement contacts, an alerting mechanism) with how to verify and how to implement each if missing.

Implementation Guide — exact, ordered steps: inventory contracts and renewal dates, build the repository and calendar, map OEM bundles, set lead-time alerts, define the renewal decision workflow with procurement, then pilot, validate, and expand.

5 PowerShell scripts — contract/renewal discovery, renewal-data completeness validation, a renewal calendar and cost report, safe remediation of missing renewal records, and a renewal-owner group builder.
Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with explicit pass/fail gates, plus field-proven Best Practices for the assign-once, repeat-everywhere model.
short: A repeatable software renewals, contracts, and OEM bundle tracking process — a renewal calendar with lead-time alerts, a contract repository, OEM mapping, and procurement coordination so every renewal is a planned decision. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
short_plain: A repeatable software renewals, contracts, and OEM bundle tracking process — renewal calendar with alerts, a contract repository, OEM mapping, and procurement coordination.
